scope: Flat ground, existing standing policy plus torque-driven leg trajectory; no new RL training. Continuous forward/backward rolling jumps and higher default jump.

acceptance.rolling_recovery: 1.2 continuous seconds with both normal forces >5 N, posture/rate/length limits, forward speed error <0.08 m/s and lateral speed <0.025 m/s; no zero wheel speed requirement while driving
acceptance.final_report: Also requires quiet final stand, no physical/time resets or nonwheel contact, finite signals, all requested jumps complete and successful

changes.velocity_during_launch: Captured at space press, preserved through crouch/hold/push/flight; latest user target resumes at contact
changes.parking: Original bounded target feedback preserved when stopped; moving launch never pulls back to takeoff point

standing_sample_protocol: Zero user velocity, idle, at least 2 s after startup, jump completion and last nonzero user velocity. No samples excluded based on motion quality. Moving stop samples still include settling; final 3 s is reported separately.

shared_physics.note: Unrelated pre-existing WheelLiftKeyboard/test changes remain local and are not part of this change; new stand uses JumpKeyboard.

protocols.scope: Standing and straight rolling flat-ground jumps with existing RL wheels and explicit leg control; no new RL training.

automated_tests.note: Full suite passed in an exported staged tree containing the committed WheelLiftKeyboard and test, independently of the two pre-existing local edits. Four stationary jumps also passed in that exported tree.

limitations: Only flat ground and straight motion validated; acceleration/turning does not arm a jump. Keep straight commands through recovery.
Default 10 cm stance: about 4.9 cm simultaneous wheel clearance, 0.18 s continuous flight, 6.2 cm body rise. Height changes with stance; 14 cm stance has less extension reserve.
Landing/parking has several seconds of transient wheel motion; steady-state RMS and stop transient RMS must not be conflated.
Existing compliant loop closure remains; peak closure error around 5.2 mm in these protocols. Native spherical tread/contact preset retained.
Foot contact evidence is sampled at 50 Hz, maximum contact norms are accumulated across 2 kHz physics substeps.
